research_scope: DLC Extra Pack 2 Parallel Quest skills from PQ 119-122, screened against the canonical skill index and prior research batches. Non-skill rewards and Tokipedia-only skills excluded.

verification_audit.method: PQ numbering and reward identity reconciled against the all-PQ reward guide, DLC documentation, and individual skill references. Exact drop probabilities were not inferred where sources did not establish them.

duplicate_screening.notes: Godly Display, Sneaky Strike, Confusion Blade, Energy Minefield, Remote Serious Bomb and other Extra Pack 2 skills were not duplicated because they are not PQ 119-122 skill rewards in the documented reward tables or are already represented elsewhere.

records.name: Rough Ranger
records.skill_description: A defensive counter that responds differently to Strike and Ki Blast attacks, kicking away Strike attackers or creating an energy field against Ki Blasts.

records.name: Power Impact
records.skill_description: A chargeable Ki Blast that increases Ultimate Attack power for 20 seconds when fully charged.

records.name: Meditation
records.skill_description: A meditation stance that temporarily raises maximum Ki and grants Ki auto-recovery after completion.

records.name: Power Rush
records.skill_description: A 14-hit Strike Ultimate requiring 1000 Ki and delivering a powerful rushdown attack.
